f.title: Retain trial records securely and make them available to authorities
f.statement: Clinical trial-related records should be retained securely by sponsors and investigators for the required period and be available to regulatory authorities on request to enable reconstruction of trial conduct and results.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: Clinical trial-related records should be retained securely by sponsors and investigators for the required period of time and should be available to regulatory authorities upon request
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Ensure medical care for participants with trial-related adverse events
f.statement: During and following participation, the investigator/institution should ensure adequate medical care for any trial-related adverse events, including clinically significant laboratory values, and inform participants when care is needed for intercurrent illness.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: During and following a subject's participation in a trial, the investigator/institution should ensure that adequate medical care is provided to a participant for any adverse events, including clinically significant laboratory values, related to the trial.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Maintain essential documents and protect them from premature destruction
f.statement: The investigator/institution should maintain the trial essential documents as specified and required by regulation, and take measures to prevent their accidental or premature destruction; essential documents should be retained at the site after the last marketing approval for the appropriate period.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: The investigator/institution should take measures to prevent accidental or premature destruction of these documents.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Inform investigators in writing of document retention requirements
f.statement: It is the responsibility of the sponsor to inform the investigator/institution in writing about the overall retention of documents and the period required for retention.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: It is the responsibility of the sponsor to inform the investigator/institution about overall retention of the documents and period required for retention in writing.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Give monitors, auditors, ethics committees and the Authority direct access to trial records
f.statement: Upon request of the monitor, auditor, IRB/NRERB or the regulatory authority, the investigator/institution should make all requested trial-related records available for direct access.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Data integrity & records

rows.quote: Upon request of the monitor, auditor, IRB/NRERB, or the regulatory authority, the investigator/institution should make available for direct access all requested trial-related records.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Report changes that increase risk to subjects promptly in writing
f.statement: The investigator should promptly provide written reports to the sponsor, the NRERB/IRB and the Authority on any changes significantly affecting the conduct of the trial and/or increasing the risk to subjects.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: The investigator should promptly provide written reports to the sponsor, the NRERB/IRB and, the Authority on any changes significantly affecting the conduct of the trial, and/or increasing the risk to subjects.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Investigator reports SAEs to the sponsor within 24 hours, followed by detailed reports
f.statement: All SAEs should be reported to the sponsor within 24 hours, except those the protocol or IB identifies as not needing immediate reporting; immediate reports should be followed promptly by detailed written reports identifying subjects by unique code numbers rather than names, personal identification numbers or addresses.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)
f.exceptions: SAEs identified in the protocol or IB as not needing immediate reporting
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: All serious adverse events (SAEs) should be reported within 24 hours to the sponsor except for those SAEs that the protocol or other document (e.g. Investigator’s Brochure) identifies as not needing immediate reporting.
rows.review_note: Review: source does not state when the 24 hours start; no deadline_rule. Double-check: ok.

f.title: Investigator reports serious adverse drug events to EFDA within 48 hours of occurrence
f.statement: The investigator should also report all serious adverse drug events to the Authority within 48 hours of the occurrence of the SAE.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.deadline: Within 48 hours of the occurrence of the SAE
rows.quote: The investigator should also report all serious adverse drug events to the Authority within 48 hours of the occurrence of the SAE.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Report protocol-specified critical AEs and lab abnormalities as required
f.statement: Adverse events and laboratory abnormalities identified in the protocol as critical to safety evaluations should be reported to the sponsor per the protocol's requirements and time periods, and must be reported to the Authority per regulatory requirements.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: These types of adverse events must be reported to the Authority as per regulatory requirements.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Provide additional information on reported deaths
f.statement: For reported deaths, the investigator should supply the sponsor and the Authority with any additional requested information (e.g. autopsy reports and terminal medical reports).
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: For reported deaths, the investigator should supply the sponsor and the Authority with any additional requested information (e.g., autopsy reports and terminal medical reports).
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: On premature termination, ensure subject follow-up and inform the Authority
f.statement: If a trial is prematurely terminated or suspended, the investigator/institution should promptly inform subjects, assure appropriate therapy and follow-up, and inform the regulatory authority; when the sponsor stops a trial it is required to notify the authority and investigators of the reasons.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: If the trial is prematurely terminated or suspended for any reason, the investigator/ institution should promptly inform the trial subjects, should assure appropriate therapy and follow-up for the subjects, and should inform the regulatory authority (ies).
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Monitor that adverse events are reported within required timelines
f.statement: Sponsor monitoring should determine whether adverse events are appropriately reported within the time periods required by the protocol, GCP and applicable regulations, and confirm that investigators maintain essential records and arrangements for their retention.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Quality system & CAPA

rows.quote: Determining whether adverse events are appropriately reported within the time periods required by the protocol, GCP and the applicable regulatory requirement(s).
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Sponsor is responsible for ongoing safety evaluation of the investigational product
f.statement: The sponsor is responsible for the ongoing safety evaluation of the investigational product(s); the Investigator's Brochure (or basic product information) forms the basis of safety assessment and reporting.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: The sponsor is responsible for the ongoing safety evaluation of the investigational product(s).
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Review safety information regularly and share new information promptly
f.statement: The sponsor should compile and review relevant safety information regularly, update the protocol, IB and consent documents as needed, assess whether new information could affect participants' willingness to continue, trial conduct or approvals, and share it promptly with participants, investigators, NRERB and regulators as appropriate.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: This kind of information should be promptly shared with the participants, investigator, NRERB, and regulatory agencies, if appropriate.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Submit safety updates and periodic reports including IB changes
f.statement: The sponsor should submit safety updates and periodic reports, including changes to the Investigator's Brochure, to the regulatory authorities as required.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: The sponsor should submit to the regulatory authority (ies) safety updates and periodic reports, including changes to the Investigator’s Brochure, as required by applicable regulatory requirements.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Expedite reporting of SUSARs per ICH E2A
f.statement: The sponsor should expedite reporting to regulatory authorities of all ADRs that are suspected, unexpected and serious (SUSARs), in line with regulatory requirements and ICH E2A.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: expedite the reporting to the regulatory authority(ies) of all adverse drug reactions (ADRs) that meet three criteria: suspected, unexpected and serious (i.e., SUSARs).

f.title: Assess expectedness against the reference safety information
f.statement: Safety reporting should evaluate the expectedness of the reaction against the applicable product information, such as the reference safety information in the Investigator's Brochure.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

f.title: Report SUSARs to investigators, institutions and ethics committees
f.statement: SUSARs should be reported to the appropriate investigators, institutions and NRERB in a way that emphasises the need for prompt action; periodic line listings with an overall safety assessment may be appropriate.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: Reporting SUSARs to the appropriate investigator(s), institution(s), NRERB should be done in a way that emphasizes the need for prompt action
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Report urgent safety issues without undue delay
f.statement: Urgent safety issues requiring immediate attention or action should be reported to the NRERB and/or regulatory authorities and investigators without undue delay.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: Urgent safety issues requiring immediate attention or action should be reported to the NRERB and/or regulatory authority (ies) and investigators without undue delay
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Agree alternative safety reporting arrangements in advance and describe them in the protocol
f.statement: Alternative arrangements for safety reporting (e.g. SAEs that are efficacy or safety endpoints not subject to unblinding and expedited reporting) should be prospectively agreed with the regulatory authority and NRERB and described in the protocol.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: Alternative arrangements for safety reporting to regulatory authorities, NRERB, and investigators and for reporting by investigators to the sponsor should be prospectively agreed upon
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Act on immediate hazards and report them with protocol revisions
f.statement: The sponsor should act quickly on participant hazards, identify their sources and implement corrective measures; the investigator/institution or sponsor shall report the immediate hazard and any subsequent protocol revision to the NRERB and/or regulatory authorities.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Risk management & minimisation

rows.quote: The investigator/institution or sponsor shall, in compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, report the information on the immediate hazard and any subsequent protocol revision to the NRERB and/or regulatory authorities.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Keep the Investigator's Brochure updated with significant new information
f.statement: The sponsor should ensure the IB is developed and updated as significant new information on the investigational product becomes available; the IB should describe anticipated risks and ADRs and the precautions or special monitoring required.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: The sponsor should ensure that an Investigator’s Brochure is developed and updated as significant new information on the investigational product becomes available.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Provide emergency unblinding and protect the blind when unblinding for safety reporting
f.statement: In blinded trials the sponsor should implement a blinding process that prevents and detects inappropriate unblinding, a mechanism for investigators to rapidly identify the product in a medical emergency, and a mechanism that protects the blind where a participant is unblinded for safety reporting to regulators/NRERB.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety system configuration

rows.quote: a mechanism that protects the blinding of the trial where a participant’s treatment assignment is unblinded for the purpose of safety reporting to regulatory authorities and/or NRERB, where appropriate.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Document unblinding: who, when, why and safeguards
f.statement: Procedures should describe unblinding, including who was unblinded, when and for what purpose, who should remain blinded, and safeguards to preserve the blind.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Clinical safety monitoring

rows.quote: who was unblinded, at what time point and for what purpose they were unblinded;

f.title: Retain sponsor essential records and manage retention notices and ownership transfers
f.statement: The sponsor should retain all sponsor-specific essential records as required; inform investigators/institutions and service providers in writing of retention needs and when records are no longer needed; and report any transfer of ownership of essential records to the appropriate authority.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

rows.quote: The sponsor (or subsequent owners of the data) should retain all of the sponsor-specific essential records pertaining to the trial in conformance with the applicable regulatory requirement(s).
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Secure direct access to source records for monitoring, audit and inspection
f.statement: The sponsor should ensure the protocol or agreement provides for direct access by investigators/institutions to source records for monitoring, audits, NRERB review and inspection, and that participants consent to such access.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Data integrity & records

rows.quote: The sponsor should ensure that it is specified in the protocol or other documented agreement that the investigator(s)/institution(s) provide direct access to source records for trial-related monitoring, audits, NRERB review and regulatory inspection.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.

f.title: Establish a DSMB where needed and transmit DSMB reports to the IRB
f.statement: The responsibility to establish a DSMB typically falls on the sponsor; the DSMB reviews cumulative safety data, SAEs and unexpected AEs and reports to the sponsor and IRBs, and the investigator is required to transmit the DSMB summary report to the local IRB.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)

f.title: Specify safety parameters and AE recording and reporting procedures in the protocol
f.statement: The protocol should specify safety parameters, methods and timing for assessing, recording and analysing them, procedures for eliciting, recording and reporting adverse events and intercurrent illnesses, and the type and duration of follow-up after adverse events.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Ethiopia (scope: safety reporting, safety monitoring and related record keeping only)
